Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual 9-slice popup frame sprite for a friendly creature collecting game, not a mockup.
Create exactly ONE square frame on a genuinely transparent background. BOTH the exterior outside the rounded frame AND the entire central opening must have alpha transparency. No filled panel, no lettering, no guide lines, no drop shadow.
Reference images 1 and 2 are style references only: match their bold dark plum outlines, very simple chunky friendly shapes and two-tone flat cel shading. Neutral warm ivory and stone/taupe so it works over blue, green, orange, purple and sandy game backgrounds. Avoid saturated purple/gold/blue trim and avoid any theme-specific symbols.
Design: a rounded square picture-frame ring, thick dark plum outer contour, warm ivory stone band, single simple muted taupe bevel, thick dark plum inner contour. Only one small diagonal bevel accent at each corner. No gems, no studs, no scrollwork, no rivets, no decorative marks anywhere along straight edges. No grain, noise or textures. Simple and bold.
PRECISE GEOMETRY, expressed on the intended 256 by 256 final canvas (scale these values proportionally if generating larger): outer frame extents x=4..252, y=4..252; rounded outer corners radius 28. The transparent inner opening has straight boundaries x=56, x=200, y=56, y=200, small rounded inside corners radius 12. Outer outline about 8 pixels thick, inner outline about 6 pixels thick. All ornamentation and corner transitions must be confined strictly to the four 80x80 corner regions. The slice cuts will be x=80 and176, y=80 and176. The four middle edge strips must be perfectly straight, constant thickness, completely untextured and uniform from end to end, so repeating or stretching them creates no seam. The 96x96 central slice must be COMPLETELY transparent. Top and bottom must be parallel and perfectly horizontal, left and right perfectly vertical. Orthographic front view, no perspective, no tilt.
There is no scene, no presentation sheet, no label, no second object. Output just this simple clean production-ready frame PNG.

No texture, grain, gradient, shading, patterns, markings, borders, vignettes, light direction, objects, text or transparency. Every pixel should be the same light warm ivory colour. This intentionally plain untextured fill matches the inside of a simple neutral cartoon game panel.
